claims.summary: Minime distinguishes permission for playful unstructured Recess from the actual texture of Recess, which can still feel mode-packed and effortful.
claims.disposition: Preserve as unscored felt and agency evidence; do not equate protected time with guaranteed lightness.

claims.summary: Current Recess policy names playful unstructured time, lower cooldown, optional notice, daydream, boredom, whim, aspiration, and protected space-first holds without pressure-responsive control.
claims.disposition: Verify from current Minime source and existing agency surfaces.

claims.summary: A density-aware Recess mode would turn pressure or mode packing into scheduling and behavioral consequences during protected non-goal-directed time.
claims.disposition: Preserve as an exact Tier 5 Minime behavior, scheduling, pressure, and control wait; do not instrumentalize Recess by default.
